title: Jurong Shipyard staff welcomed at Changi Airport
summary: Global HR greeted one of our largest group arrivals from India for Jurong Shipyard at Singapore Changi Airport.
body:
Global HR staff welcomed Jurong Shipyard recruits at Changi Airport as part of one of our largest group recruitment projects from India.

Candidates received arrival briefings, travel support, and a warm welcome before reporting to their employer partners in Singapore.

title: CVT electrical course graduation ceremony
summary: Graduates completed the electrical installation course and received certificates at our training centre.
body:
Congratulations to the latest cohort who completed the CVT electrical installation course.

The certification ceremony recognised their practical skills and readiness for overseas employment in technical roles.

title: Forklift drivers briefing by Sankyu Singapore
summary: Selected forklift driver candidates attended a pre-departure briefing with Sankyu Singapore.
body:
Global HR organised a briefing session for selected forklift driver candidates ahead of deployment with Sankyu Singapore.

The session covered workplace expectations, safety standards, and onboarding steps for successful placement.

title: Rotary Engineering weld test at Myanmar training centre
summary: Candidates completed practical weld testing at our Myanmar training centre for Rotary Engineering placements.
body:
Rotary Engineering candidates underwent onsite weld testing at our Myanmar training centre.

The assessment ensures technical competency before interview and deployment with employer partners.

title: Briefing for Keppel Nakilat interview
summary: Pre-interview briefing prepared marine candidates for the Keppel Nakilat selection process.
body:
Global HR conducted a structured briefing for candidates shortlisted for Keppel Nakilat interviews.

The session covered interview format, technical expectations, and professional conduct for marine sector roles.
